about: E34 Amendment 10, 2026-11-02. The comparison of Amendment 9, weighted by the inputs the model sees: option (a) of log card decision-commute-settled, the user's choice. Does the commute line's headline read 'copies the fine-tune's change on real inputs' or 'reproduces its behaviour by a different change'? Plan reports/plans/2026-11-02_plan_e34-amend10-input-weighted.md. Saved states, one forward of W0 and one fine-tune rerun, one free cluster job. Filed before the run. Stage 0 alone (Frobenius, no model, no input) was run before filing to find the expected values and a bug; its numbers are in expected.frobenius_known_before_filing. Nothing weighted by inputs has been read. Design check: approved by the user; class 1, analysis of what exists.
request_in_the_terms_words: For each saved student of a teacher training, its weight change S = (U + dU)(V + dV)^T - U V^T from W0's alive (U, V), and its fine-tune's finished update dW. For two changes A, B the inner product is, over the 24 matrices together, sum_k tr(A_k Sigma_k B_k^T) = E sum_k <A_k x, B_k x>, x the input matrix k sees and Sigma_k = E[x x^T]. Read the cosine of S with dW under it, and beside it, against the same dW: a rerun of the same fine-tune, a different task's fine-tune and the same table's other seed's student.

states.students: Amendment 9's ten, all present (checked by load_vectors in the dry run of stage 0): E12 Amendment 2's rand32_s0, rand32_s1, rand32b_s0, rand32b_s0_o1, rand32b_s1, rand32b_s1_o1 (new_vs_existing/results/large/amend2/); Amendment 8c's real_o0, real_o1, null_o0, null_o1 (amend8/amend8c/). U, V: amend8c/uv0.pt. In this code E12's students are named S_<name>, because E12 named a student after its fine-tune.
states.fine_tunes: Amendment 9's six: regating_table/results/large/{rand32,rand32b}_{s0,s1}.pt (rand32 step 10, rand32b step 30, fp32), amend8c/{real,null}_teacher_dW.pt (Adam 3e-5, steps 1,000 and 100, bf16).
states.rerun: real_teacher_o1, trained in this job and saved bf16 as results/large/amend10/real_teacher_o1_dW.pt: amend8.real_teacher's recipe at batch order 1. No rerun of the null fine-tune: it has no verdict

inputs.model: W0's activations for every read, whichever pair. One fixed x for both sides: then there is one inner product, each cosine is symmetric, and every reference is read in the same metric. Neither the student's nor the fine-tuned model's own activations are favoured, W0 is where (U, V) and Gamma were fitted, and the reads are first order in the change, so the change in x is second order. Blind to that second-order part
inputs.task: task:<t>: every position of the task's held-out windows: 73 windows on emoticon, 97 on each map table, 41 positions each, held out of both the fine-tune's and the student's training. Text around the trigger, with the trigger 1 position in 41
inputs.trigger: trigger:<t>: position `half` alone of the same windows, where the taught behaviour is read. Sigma has rank at most the window count, 73 or 97, against d_in 768 or 3072, so its noise is high; P4 reads it and it does not enter the wording. It leaves out the k and v inputs of earlier positions that attention reads at the trigger
inputs.pile: pile: every position of Pile val rows 0 to 255, the harness's rows (faithfulness.pile_blocks), 131,072 positions
inputs.reads: `model(rows, cache_type='input').cache`, as vpd.compute_ci reads it, with no autocast (weight_side.inputs_and_gates's form), fp32 forward, x x^T and every matrix product in fp64. The rerun alone trains, under the recipe's bf16 autocast
inputs.mean: Uncentred is the request's own inner product: a constant output shift is real behaviour downstream. Centred, Sigma - mu mu^T, is read beside it, and the verdicts need both to agree, so a result the mean alone carries reads 'mixed' and goes to 'cannot tell'
inputs.normalisation: Over all matrices together, as Amendment 9. Per-matrix inner products are saved in results/large/amend10/gram_<set>.pt and read by no rule. top_matrix_share, read later from those files, says whether one matrix carries the pooled number
inputs.layout: The 67M's 24 matrices are nn.Linear, (d_out, d_in); `vpd.target_linear` asserts it, so there is no Conv1D here. S and dW share that layout: Amendment 9's check read the transposed layout at most 0.0013. The layout control below tests x against the module

measurements.cos: <A, B>_Sigma / sqrt(<A, A>_Sigma <B, B>_Sigma), absolute. Per input set, per form (uncentred, centred), per part (whole, windows in alternate halves A and B). Read: `S | dW` own; `dW' | dW` rerun; other fine-tune against dW; other seed's student against dW
measurements.margin: Per kind of input and form: the largest of gap_min, the largest |A - B| over every cell the rules read, the largest batch-order change (rand32b's two seeds, real), and one bf16 rounding draw. Conservative: |A - B| compares two half-size samples, against reads on the whole set
measurements.concentration: Not in the results file. Read by the analysis from gram_<set>.pt: for each dW, the largest single matrix's share of E||dW x||^2 (top_matrix_share), and the mean input's share (mean_share)
measurements.frobenius: The same cosines with Sigma = I, for comparison and the re-read control
measurements.ladder: Reported: E53's cipher rerun at steps 10, 100, 300 on Pile. How a rerun moves with length. No rule reads it

the_inside_part: Not read. Under this inner product it is no longer an orthogonal part of dW, and it has no expected value here. The main read is against dW itself

predictions.kind: classification, the map tables and the headline
predictions.rule: table_label per E12 student s against its own fine-tune r on the task's windows and on Pile, each uncentred and centred. own = cos(S, r); rerun = cos(r', r), r' the same table's other seed; other_task = the largest of cos(f, r) over the other table's two fine-tunes, the real and the null; m = the margin. Anything not finite: 'unscorable'. rerun under 0.1, or rerun - other_task under 2 m: 'cannot tell', the references do not separate. Else own >= rerun - m: 'copies'. Else 'different change'. Inclusive. A verdict per input kind over all six students and both forms: one label if all agree, 'unscorable' if any is, else 'mixed'. Absolute cosines, compared with a reference. wording(map_task, map_pile, real_task, real_pile), P2 supplying the real pair: any 'unscorable': 'unscorable'. Any not 'copies' or 'different change' ('cannot tell', 'mixed'): 'cannot tell'. All four 'copies': 'copies the fine-tune's change on real inputs'. All four 'different change': 'reproduces its behaviour by a different change'. Map tables and real task alike, task windows and Pile different: 'depends on the inputs'. Task windows and Pile alike, map tables and real task different: 'depends on the task'. Otherwise 'cannot tell'. The scope field names the four labels
predictions.what_copies_means: A student no further from the fine-tune than another run of that fine-tune is, on these inputs, within the noise. The rerun shares the task's part of the update and differs in its batches' part, so with r = T + n, r' = T + n', a student of exactly T reads sqrt(rerun), and one of T plus a noise of the same size reads rerun. So 'copies' means at the level of a rerun, not an identical change. P3 says whether it follows this run or only the task
predictions.can_read_either_way: No arithmetic fixes it. own, rerun and other_task are all unread on inputs. tests/test_teacher_amend10.py runs score() on made-up reads to each label. Amendment 9's flaw, a wording true of any student by construction, does not recur: 'copies' fails if the student is further from dW than a rerun, 'different change' fails if not, and neither wording's truth follows from S lying in what the subcomponents can write
predictions.lean: 'reproduces its behaviour by a different change', medium-low. Students read 0.25 to 0.41 by Frobenius against reruns of 0.61 and 0.68, and weighting has to close that gap on inputs for 'copies'. A student was trained on outputs, so input weighting should raise its read more than a rerun's; how far is the open number. Second lean 'cannot tell', if task windows' margins are large
predictions.what_it_decides: The wording of the commute line's headline on this model. The line closes on this model with it. 'cannot tell' or 'depends on the inputs' go to the user with the reads: the line can still close, with that stated
predictions.blind_to: What downstream layers do with each matrix's output: it reads each matrix's output on inputs, with no regard to whether a difference there matters or cancels later. First order: S and dW are read on W0's x, as if nothing upstream moved. Only a real behaviour test closes either. Pooling: a large-output matrix counts more, and top_matrix_share shows if one carries it. Size: a cosine ignores length. A rerun differs from a fine-tune in batch order alone: the_rerun.limits_on_comparing
predictions.positive_control: The power control: a change built to match dW on the excited directions reads near 1 here and low by Frobenius. Stop if not
predictions.noise_floor: The margin, stated per input kind and form in the results

predictions.kind: classification, the same rule as the map tables
predictions.rule: table_label per real_o0, real_o1 against the real fine-tune, on task windows and Pile, uncentred and centred. rerun = cos(real_teacher_o1, real fine-tune); other_task = the largest of cos(f, real fine-tune) over the four map fine-tunes and the null; m the margin of that input kind and form. A verdict per input kind over both students and both forms, by the same agree. Not labelled limited: the_rerun says why, and what stays limited across families
predictions.lean: 'different change', medium-low, on both inputs: own 0.27, 0.28 by Frobenius; the rerun unread, and E53's cipher at 300 steps reads 0.84
predictions.what_it_decides: With P1's map tables, the wording. Disagreeing with them gives 'depends on the task', which cannot separate task from length
predictions.blind_to: As P1, and the_rerun.limits_on_comparing. One rerun
predictions.positive_control: The power control on the real fine-tune, task windows and Pile. The recipe's order 0 against the saved teacher

predictions.rule: seed_class per E12 student against its own fine-tune, same reads and forms as P1, on task windows and Pile. others = the same table's other seed's students against that fine-tune. Not finite or no others: 'unscorable'. own - max(others) >= m: 'follows its own run'. Else 'follows the task only'. By agree per input kind. Absolute
predictions.lean: 'follows the task only' or 'mixed', medium-low: by Frobenius own against other seed is 0.05 to 0.07 on the states in the dry run, about the least margin
predictions.what_it_decides: With 'copies' in P1: 'follows the task only' makes the wording 'copies the task's change, not this run's', named in the report. No effect on 'different change'
predictions.blind_to: Two seeds per table. Not read on the real task: no student of its rerun exists
predictions.positive_control: None of its own: the zero-noise path is tested on made-up reads

predictions.rule: table_label on trigger:<t>, map tables and real task alike, with the trigger's margin and the same forms
predictions.lean: 'cannot tell', medium: Sigma has rank at most 73 or 97, so split halves of 36 to 48 inputs should give a large margin
predictions.what_it_decides: Nothing alone. If it decides, and differently from the windows' verdict, the report says the wording does not hold at the trigger itself. A behaviour on the task is read there
predictions.blind_to: As P1, and the earlier positions' k and v inputs
predictions.positive_control: None of its own: the power control on the same task's windows

controls.first_and_alone: Stage 0, no model: the Frobenius re-read of every pair in amend9.json within ctrl_tol; every vector against itself 1 within ctrl_tol; the zero change reads nan on its row. Then, before any input set: the layout control, then the rerun stage; stage 0 again with the rerun in. Per input set, before any read is written: self within ctrl_tol, zero nan, Gram asymmetry within ctrl_tol, a positive smallest diagonal. Per task-windows set and Pile, before its Gram: the power control. Any miss stops the job
controls.layout: On 4 windows at W0 + the real dW: the module's output against x (W0 + dW)^T, x from the input cache, relative error at most layout_tol on all 24 matrices. It tests that the cache holds what each matrix sees, and that dW's layout fits it
controls.power: For one fine-tune per set (real on emoticon and Pile, <t>_s0 on each map table), per matrix: Q = the top eigendirections of Sigma, the fewest reaching 1 - tail of tr(Sigma). Z = dW Q Q^T + R, R random and orthogonal to Q on the read side, ||R||^2 = rho2 ||dW||^2. cos_Sigma(Z, dW) >= 0.99 and cos_Frobenius(Z, dW) <= 0.5, or stop: the weighting has no power on this Sigma. On an isotropic Sigma no direction goes unexcited and the Frobenius side fails, as tests show. Not run on the trigger sets, where low rank passes it trivially
controls.do_nothing: The weight change dW itself: reads 1 against dW on every Sigma
controls.rerun: amend8.real_teacher's recipe. Order 0 first and alone: 1 - cos_Frobenius to the saved teacher at most saved_tol, 1e-3, and held-out P(target) at least t_p_min, 0.9946. Then order 1: P(target) at least 0.9946, or stop before any read. Each is timed and reported with size, size at step 1 and damage. Size has no stop: a batch order may move it

expected.W0: No change, S = 0: the zero denominator; cos nan on its row and column on every Sigma, by Frobenius and centred; every rule 'unscorable'. The run reads this as its `zero` row and it stops if not. A centred diagonal at or under 0 reads nan the same way
expected.do-nothing: cos 1 within 1e-6 against dW, on every Sigma, by the self control
expected.self: Each S and each dW against itself 1 within 1e-6
expected.power control: cos_Sigma at least 0.99. cos_Frobenius about 1/3 by design (1 / sqrt(1 + rho2) when dW lies in the excited directions), at most 0.5; higher to the extent dW lies outside them, or on matrices with no unexcited direction
expected.frobenius_known_before_filing: Stage 0's dry run, 2026-11-02, cpu-run: against amend9.json within 1e-12. Rerun by Frobenius, whole update: rand32 0.605, rand32b 0.675. Own: rand32 0.298, 0.320, rand32b 0.391 to 0.412, real 0.274, 0.281, null 0.366, 0.367. Other seed's student against rand32_s0 0.253, against rand32b_s0 0.343, 0.361. Different task: rand32_s0 against rand32b_s0 0.071, real against null 0.059, rand32_s0 against real 0.001
expected.reruns_on_inputs: Lean 0.6 to 0.95 on task windows and Pile, above Frobenius, low confidence: reruns share a gradient that inputs drive
expected.own_on_inputs: Lean 0.3 to 0.8, above Frobenius, low confidence
expected.other_task_on_inputs: Lean 0 to 0.4, low: the mean part may raise it
expected.margins: Task windows: split-half 0.01 to 0.15, low confidence, 36 to 48 windows per half. Pile: under 0.02, so gap_min rules there. Batch order: Amendment 9's largest 0.025 by Frobenius. Trigger: 0.1 or more
expected.rounding: One draw under 0.01. Sigma weights directions unequally, so rounding could count for more here than Frobenius's 2e-6 if S or dW is small along Sigma's top directions; hence a measured draw
expected.concentration: top_matrix_share 0.05 to 0.5, mean_share 0 to 0.5, low confidence, from gram_<set>.pt. A top_matrix_share above 0.5 is said beside the wording
expected.time: About 12 min on an L40: model load 23 s (E12 Amendment 3's logged), two 1,000-step fine-tunes about 30 s each (amend8c's sbatch note), 13 small forwards and 32 Pile batches about 2 min, 22 changes against 7 Sigmas about 2 min, 4 x 24 eigendecompositions the rest. Unrehearsed. Over 30 min the job is killed with its files kept, each set written as it finishes
expected.rerun: Order 0 reproduces 8c's numbers on an L40: cos about 1 less bf16 rounding, P(target) 0.99910, size 0.0315, damage 0.0554, size at step 1 0.00346. Order 1: P(target) above 0.9946, size within Amendment 8's 0.0301 to 0.0341 and step 1 within a few percent of 0.00346, lean; about 30 s each by amend8c.sbatch's note. cos_Frobenius to the saved teacher unread; lean 0.5 to 0.9, low
expected.null_student: Reported as null_own, no rule. Above the real student's by Frobenius, 0.37 against 0.28; lean the order holds on inputs, low

noise_floors: Sampling: split-half by alternate window; its |A - B| goes into the margin. Batch order: rand32b's two seeds and real's pair. bf16: real_o1's saved offsets and the real dW each moved by one draw, uniform within +-2^-8 relative, an upper bound on one rounding, read as |cos(moved) - cos(saved)| on the same Sigma. Second moment: fp32 activations, x x^T summed in fp64, every product in fp64; the Gram's asymmetry measures what the fp64 products lose. No autocast, so no bf16 in x. Least margin gap_min

threshold_sources.layout_tol: fp32 forward of outputs; three orders above measured fp32 rounding of a product. A wrong layout reads near 1
threshold_sources.along_min: Amendment 8c's along_min, a cosine under 0.1 is not along it
threshold_sources.gap_min: Twice Amendment 9's largest batch-order change, 0.025 (each of two reads may move by it)
threshold_sources.2 m gate: Arithmetic: own >= rerun - m must imply own at least m above other_task, so 'copies' can't be read at a student indistinguishable from another task's fine-tune
threshold_sources.tail, rho2, power_sigma_min, power_frob_: Control design, from the brief's 'near 1' and 'low': with rho2 8 the Frobenius read is 1/3 if dW lies in the excited directions; 0.99 and 0.5 leave room. Tail 1e-3: at most about rho2 x tail x d/(d-k) of the denominator, under 2% at k = d/2
threshold_sources.round_rel: Amendment 9's min_share source: bf16 rounding is at most 2^-8 of an entry
threshold_sources.the rerun as the line, in place of 0.71: The independent check of Amendment 9: the 0.71 line fails even a rerun of the same fine-tune
threshold_sources.saved_tol: Amendment 8c's saved_tol, a regeneration on the same card against a saved cosine
threshold_sources.t_p_min: Amendment 8's filed AM.t_p lower bound for T1000. The saved teacher reads 0.99910

edge_cases_run_before_filing: Re-run on the revised code, tests/test_teacher_amend10.py, 2026-11-02, no state file. table_label: nan in each argument, rerun under along_min, references just not separating and just separating, own at the line and just under it, own above the rerun, a negative own. rerun_ok: at and just under t_p_min, nan P(target), reproduced, not reproduced, nan cosine. seed_class: no others, nan, a tie, just under, own below. margin: each noise ruling, nan, no noise at all. wording: each outcome. cosines: a zero change (nan on its row and column), a negative diagonal. gram: tr(A Sigma B^T) equals E<Ax, Bx> computed by hand; identity equals Frobenius; gram minus mean_part equals the centred moment. power_change: near 1 and low on a low-rank Sigma, and failing on an isotropic one. score: made-up reads to 'copies', 'different change' and 'cannot tell', noise swallowing a gap, the real verdict moving with its rerun apart from the map tables' and 'unscorable' with no rerun, a missing student and an empty file to 'unscorable'. read_set on a fake model; one window stops it, as a split-half needs two
degeneracies_found_when_writing_the_rule: E12's students carry their fine-tune's name, so the first draft's table read a student as the fine-tune. Stage 0's Frobenius re-read stopped it at 0.70 against 1e-6. Students here are S_<name>
A gate of rerun - other_task >= m would read 'copies' at a student equal to another task's fine-tune: the gate is 2 m
Amendment 9's flaw: a wording true by construction. Neither wording here holds for every student; see P1.can_read_either_way

the_rerun.recipe: amend8.real_teacher, as Amendment 8c ran it: finetune.finetune_arm_a, ArmAConfig(o_token = windows.json's o_token_id, lr 3e-5, steps 1,000, checkpoints (1, 1,000), optimizer adam), defaults batch 32, clip 1, kl_lambda 1; transport_test's train and held-out windows; bf16 autocast in the forward, as the fine-tune ran; saved bf16
the_rerun.what_it_varies: The batch-order seed alone: the torch.Generator behind torch.randint over the training windows. Weights, windows, target, optimizer and length are the same
the_rerun.what_the_map_tables_seeds_vary: The same thing alone: anchors.kv_finetune passes seed 0 or 1 to the same finetune_arm_a, with the task's table as the target. So the real rerun and the map-table reruns are comparable in what they vary, and the real verdict is not labelled limited
the_rerun.differences_from_the_saved_teacher: Batch order, which is the point. Beyond it, none intended. Amendment 8c's job ran the W0 Pile harness first and went through harness.load; neither touches the local generator, the model is in eval mode, and _run restores W0. finetune.py last changed at e9d445d7, before 8c's files. The card: 8c's was an L40, and another card may not reproduce it. Order 0 of the recipe runs first and must reproduce the saved teacher; that control tests all of these
the_rerun.limits_on_comparing: Length differs between families, not within them. A map-table rerun is at 10 or 30 steps, the real one at 1,000. At 10 steps a seed changes which windows are drawn at all (320 draws from 403), at 1,000 every window is seen about 88 times (32,000 draws from 365), so the seed may leave less difference and the real rerun may read higher: E53's cipher rerun rose with length by Frobenius, 0.14, 0.42, 0.84 at steps 10, 100, 300, read before this revision and read by no rule. Map-table fine-tunes stop at first learned (held-out P(target) about 0.54 to 0.58), the real one at 0.999. Map students trained 1,000 steps against a 10- or 30-step fine-tune, real ones 1,000 against 1,000. So each student is fairly read against its own family's rerun, and 'depends on the task' cannot separate task from length. One rerun, so one number with no spread of its own. Batches: real_o0 shares all 1,000 with the fine-tune, real_o1 with the rerun; both must agree, so a read inflated by shared batches can't carry 'copies' alone
